Reviewed all 50 verbs in shard 2; wrote 3 findings to `verbdata/gloss-review/shards/gloss_002.out.json`.

- `abwählen` (medium) — shipped "deselect" is the computing sense; the everyday readings are voting out of office and dropping a school subject (candidate index 1).
- `abwägen` (low) — bare "weigh" collides with `abwiegen`; abwägen is figurative weighing-up only.
- `anfallen` (medium) — shipped the literary "attack suddenly" over the modern impersonal "arise, accrue" (candidate index 3).

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
- Two defects here came from the *same* shortening step rather than the import: `abwägen`'s parenthetical ("to determine the intrinsic value or merit") was the only thing distinguishing it from physical weighing, so trimming to house style deleted the disambiguator. Terseness is safe only when the head word isn't a homograph of a neighboring verb's gloss.
- `anfallen` shows why `sense_index: 0` is weak evidence in both directions: kaikki's ordering tracks Wiktionary's historical-first editorial habit, so verbs whose oldest sense is literary (attack) and whose modern sense is grammatical/impersonal (accrue) are structurally the highest-yield place to look.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
